title: Accept two-pixel token half steps
result: The default spacing quantum is 2px. Existing exclusions and noise thresholds remain unchanged; deliberately broken fixtures now use 5/9/13px instead of legitimate 6/10/14px values. No token-configuration API was added.
evidence: The mixed 6/10/14px screen regression failed before the fix. Focused spacing and CLI tests passed 12 cases; the split unit fixtures passed 11 cases and whole-package typecheck passed. The final combined package gate is recorded in the 2026-10-22 validation entry.
